name: Complete First-Person Controller
author: FrodoUndead
description:
Controls:
W A S D - Movement
Mouse - Look
Left Shift - Sprint
Left Ctrl - Crouch
Spacebar - Jump

This is a complete first-person controller with many functions including sprinting, crouching, climbing ladders and swimming! It can be used with either a controller, or a keyboard and mouse and is completely customizable to fit your game's needs. This demo allows you to switch between the 4 Pre-Made character variants that are included in this asset. If you'd like to use this character controller in a game of your own, it is available for download on the asset store. https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/tools/physics/complete-first-person-controller-195497
